aggregation: mean of seed-specific top-ranked Vina energies per compound; lower predicts measured binding; all 3 seeds required
information_regime: known site from independent prior Gal9C glycan structure; shared across alternatives
limitations: One target domain, assay context and synthetic glycoside series; exploratory development.
Gal9 and Gal3 share the galectin fold; this is not independent receptor-family generalization.
NB at highest tested 2mM is categorical; no exact or lower-bound KD is inferred.
No energy-to-KD calibration, fitted decision threshold or classifier performance claim.
Generated ligand input coordinates provide atom identity only, not structural pose ground truth.
The 2019 SI adopts prior conditions but does not repeat an assayed sequence/tag record; treat the 2016 construct as method provenance, not an independently verified 2019 batch identity.

The entire 138-residue deposited structural core is identical to the reported assay Gal9C region; every annotated binding-site residue and every native-GAL contact residue is observed and identical. Missing N-terminal assay residues and fusion/batch provenance remain explicit approximations.

metrics.interpretation: descriptive conditional same-assay specificity; one target/scaffold; no held-out generalization

positive_only_quantitative_association.interpretation: exploratory within-assay association; no significance or generalization claim
positive_only_quantitative_association.measurement_uncertainty: correlations use reported point estimates; experimental uncertainty is not propagated

right_censored_quantitative_contrast.reason: NB at tested 2mM is an operational class, not a measured KD lower bound

metrics.score_direction: lower Vina seed-mean top1 score predicts binding
metrics.tie_policy: exact equal aggregate scores receive half concordance
